lines.beaver: 운동 끝! 너 괜찮아? 얼굴이 안 좋아.
lines.beaver_en: Workout's over! Are you okay? You don't look good.
lines.beaver_roman: undong kkeut! neo gwaenchana? eolguri an joa.
lines.learner: 아니, 허리가 너무 아파. 허리를 못 펴겠어.
lines.en: No, my back really hurts. I can't straighten it.
lines.roman: ani, heoriga neomu apa. heorireul mot pyeogesseo.

lines.en: My shoulder hurts too. My arms have no strength.

lines.learner: 오른손 손가락이 아파. 손을 못 펴.
lines.en: My right-hand fingers hurt. I can't open my hand.
lines.roman: oreunson songaragi apa. soneul mot pyeo.

lines.en: My left hand is fine. But my palm is red.
My knee is bleeding. I fell earlier.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no! When did you fall?
lines.learner: 달릴 때 넘어졌어. 그때 엉덩이도 아팠어.
lines.en: I fell while running. My butt hurt then too.
lines.roman: dallil ttae neomeojyeosseo. geuttae eongdeongido apasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Does it hurt a lot? Can you sit?
lines.en: No, my butt hurts, so I can't sit.

lines.beaver_en: Aren't you thirsty? Want some water?
lines.learner: 응, 목이 너무 말라. 입도 바짝 말랐어.
lines.en: Yeah, I'm so thirsty. My mouth is totally dry.
lines.roman: eung, mogi neomu malla. ipdo bajjak mallasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Here's water. The bleeding has stopped now.
lines.en: What a relief. Thanks, I'm a bit better now.

lines.beaver_en: Go home and rest well today.
lines.learner: 응, 내일은 운동 못 하겠어. 잘 가!
lines.en: Okay, I can't work out tomorrow. Bye!
lines.roman: eung, naeireun undong mot hagesseo. jal ga!
